Explanation:  
The question asks for the last prose book written by the poet who referred to Wyndham Lewis as "that lonely old volcano of the Right." The Predicted Answer correctly identifies the poet as W. H. Auden, but states his last major prose book was "A Certain World: A Commonplace Book (1970)," whereas the Ground Truth Answer is "Forewords and Afterwords (1973)." "Forewords and Afterwords" was published after "A Certain World" and is indeed a prose work. Therefore, the substance of the Ground Truth Answer is not present in the Predicted Answer—the LLM provided the wrong title and year for the last prose book.

Decision: FALSE
